description.value: St. James's Well is an authentic Irish pub that has anchored Port Moody's Newport Village since 1999, offering hearty Celtic fare including its signature Stuffed Yorkies, Guinness steak pie, and an extensive rotating selection of local BC craft beers alongside imported Irish ales. The interior features rustic wooden beams and Irish memorabilia, with a heated outdoor patio for year-round dining. The pub is within walking distance of the Port Moody Inlet SkyTrain station, making it a convenient stop for cyclists combining riding with transit.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at stjameswell.ca confirmed address (248 Newport Dr, Port Moody, BC V3H 5B9), phone ((604) 461-0800), and active operation as a full-service Irish pub with indoor dining and a heated outdoor patio; the About page explicitly states 'We also offer vegetarian options' and the menu labels multiple dishes (GF), confirming dietary options. Takeout is confirmed via an explicit Uber Eats call-to-action on the website. No mention of bike parking, water bottle refill, Wi-Fi, or device charging was found in either the website content or OSM tags.
